channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Collision on N71 Rosscarbery
item.description: Reports of a collision on the N71 Rosscarbery, near the Celtic Ross Hotel. Emergency services are on scene. Take care on approach.

item.title: M28 Cork to Ringaskiddy: Works Advancing Across Multiple Locations
item.description: M28 works update: progress at Rochestown, Carr's Hill & Shannonpark with traffic management in place.

item.title: Collision at Copsetown Newtwopothouse
item.description: Reports of a collision near Copsetown, Newtwopothouse. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision near Dromdeer
item.description: Reports of a collision (overturned vehicle) near Dromdeer (Doneraile). Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Road Closure on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a road closure due to debris on road, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road at N40(E) Off-Slip (Douglas West),Junction 8,N40E. Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 22 February at 14:00.

item.title: Breakdown on N22 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a breakdown, eastbound, on the N22 between R618 Toonlane and R582 Gurteenroe (near Macroom). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 22 February at 19:37.

item.title: Cork's Iconic Savoy Returns: Historic Venue Reopens After Ten-Year Closure
item.description: Cork's iconic Savoy on St Patrick's Street has reopened after 10 years, with live music, two rooms and nearly 600 capacity.

item.title: Breakdown on N22 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a breakdown, eastbound, on the N22 between R618 Toonlane and R582 Gurteenroe (2 kilometres west of the Macroom area). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 22 February at 23:36.

item.title: Crime Falls Across Most Categories in Ireland as Fraud Surges
item.description: Gardaí report major falls in most crime categories in 2025, but fraud offences surged 137% as online criminal activity continues to rise.

item.title: Collision on College Road
item.description: Reports of a collision at the junction of College Road, and Highfield Avenue (near Daybreak.) Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.
